item.title: Solved: How to Print Entire Raw HTTP Requests using Python Requests
item.description:
While working with the requests module in Python, have you ever found yourself pondering if there’s a straightforward method to print the complete raw HTTP request? Wouldn’t it be useful to see not just the headers, but the entire request line, headers, and body content that is ultimately constructed for the HTTP request? This post will walk you through several effective methods to achieve this using Python’s requests library.
